model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the ‘effect’ values for various language models, categorized by language family. The horizontal axis represents the language families, including IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, ordered from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled ‘effect’, ranges from approximately 0 to 30 and utilizes a linear scale with tick intervals of 5, displaying values in units of ‘effect’.  Each bar represents a specific language model, with the height of each bar indicating its ‘effect’ value, accompanied by error bars representing the standard error. The ‘mBERT-L2’ bar, colored in yellow, is the tallest, reaching a value of approximately 28. The ‘mBERT-R2’ bar, colored in orange, is approximately 25 units high. The ‘XLM-L2’ bar, colored in gray, is approximately 22 units high, while the ‘mBERT-R2’ bar, colored in brown, is approximately 20 units high. The ‘mBERT-B2’ bar, colored in dark red, is approximately 16 units high, and the ‘XLM-B2’ bar, colored in light red, is approximately 13 units high.  The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized.
